en.label: [section] Aim of the course and learning outcomes:
en.content: The aim of the course is to acquaint students with the principles of individual machines and equipment used in technology processing of fruit and vegetables into semi-finished and final products. After completing the course, students should be able to build the necessary production line for a technological procedure.
